title: Beyond Outcome Rewards: Constructing and Assigning Retrieval Credit for Search Agents
title_zh: Beyond Outcome Rewards: 构建和分配检索信用以构建搜索代理

paragraphs.en: Search agents enable Large Language Models (LLMs) to iteratively retrieve and use information for complex multi-hop questions. Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) offers a promising approach for post-training such agents, but its reliance on sparse, outcome-based supervision can make credit assignment difficult and limit learning efficiency. In this paper, we systematically investigate how intermediate supervision can improve reinforcement learning for search agents. We study a range of reward-shaping and credit-assignment strategies that provide learning signals from intermediate retrieval steps. Building on these insights, we develop a training framework that combines intermediate signals with final outcome rewards to improve learning from multi-step search trajectories. Experiments across multiple benchmarks under matched training conditions demonstrate improvements in aggregate search-agent performance and show that both the choice of intermediate signal and where its credit is assigned affect training behaviour. These findings show that reward design and credit assignment are important design dimensions for training effective search agents.

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) allows large language models to answer questions using external evidence. For complex questions, the required evidence may be spread across several documents, and an initial retrieval may reveal what the model needs to search for next. Search agents such as Search-o1 ( Li et al., 2025a ) address this problem by interleaving reasoning with retrieval, using each observation to guide subsequent actions. Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025b ) and ReSearch ( Chen et al., 2025 ) use reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to train this behaviour from answer feedback. Through interaction with a search environment, the policy learns which queries to issue and how to use the returned information to answer the question.

paragraphs.en: A final outcome reward, however, provides limited information about the searches along the way. Two trajectories can both receive zero answer reward even though one retrieves part of the required evidence and the other retrieves none. When all rollouts in a question group receive the same answer score, group-relative training supplies no outcome advantage, leaving differences in retrieval progress unused. Intermediate supervision can make this progress available to the learner before it produces a correct final answer. Yet a retrieval score alone does not specify how to update the policy: the same evidence gain can change the reward for the whole trajectory or provide credit to the particular search that produced it.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，最终结果奖励所提供的关于途中搜索过程的信息十分有限。 即使一条轨迹获取了部分所需证据，而另一条则完全没有获取，两条轨迹都可能会获得零答案奖励。 当一个问题组中的所有展开过程都获得相同的答案分数时，组内相对训练无法提供任何结果上的优势，导致检索进展的差异未被利用。 中间监督可以在学习者尚未得出正确最终答案之前，使其能够利用这些进展信息。 但仅凭检索分数本身并不能明确如何更新策略：相同的证据增益既可以改变整个轨迹的奖励，也可以将信用归于产生该证据的具体搜索过程。

paragraphs.en: We therefore investigate how intermediate retrieval supervision depends on its credit assignment. We study two connected choices: what retrieved information should earn a reward, and how that reward should enter the policy update. A search can retrieve a fact before finding the evidence needed to establish its prerequisites. Rewarding that fact immediately recognises evidence already acquired, while waiting for its prerequisites rewards progress through the annotated dependency structure. These choices can assign credit to different searches even when the agent eventually retrieves the same evidence. Adding that credit to the final reward changes the shared advantage for the whole trajectory, whereas assigning it locally changes the update on a particular search action. Comparing retrieval signals under both formulations lets us examine whether a signal’s benefit persists across these choices.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们研究了中间检索监督如何依赖于其信用分配。 我们研究两个相互关联的选择：哪些检索到的信息应获得奖励，以及该奖励应如何进入策略更新。 在找到确立其前提条件所需的证据之前，一次搜索可能会先检索到一个事实。 立即奖励该事实会认可已经获得的证据，而等待其前提条件则奖励了通过已标注依赖结构所取得的进展。 即使智能体最终检索到相同的证据，这些选择也可能将信用分配给不同的搜索过程。 将该信用添加到最终奖励中会改变整个轨迹的共享优势，而将其局部分配则会改变对特定搜索动作的更新。 比较这两种形式下的检索信号，有助于我们考察某种信号的优势是否在这些不同选择中保持一致。

paragraphs.en: To support this study, we develop a data construction pipeline that composes corpus-grounded relations into questions while retaining intermediate answers, supporting passages and evidence dependencies. The intermediate answers and supporting passages identify which subquestions a retrieval helps answer, while the dependency structure records how those subquestions connect. Retaining both lets us change the rule for crediting evidence while holding the questions and their grounding fixed. The same annotations also support analysis of what a trained agent retrieves, separately from whether its final answer is correct.
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持这项研究，我们开发了一条数据构建流程，该流程将基于语料库的关系组合成问题，同时保留中间答案、支持性段落和证据依赖关系。 中间答案和支持性段落可以确定检索有助于回答哪些子问题，而依赖结构则记录了这些子问题之间的连接方式。 同时保留这两者，使我们可以在保持问题和其依据不变的情况下，更改证据的归因规则。 相同的标注还支持对训练后的智能体所检索内容的分析，且这一分析与它的最终答案是否正确无关。

paragraphs.en: Using these annotations, we compare three retrieval signals on the same observations. Grounded evidence coverage (Cov) measures how much of the annotated evidence has been retrieved; coverage with dependencies (Cov-Dep) requires the same evidence to satisfy prerequisite relations; answer match (AM) checks for a reference answer in the retrieved text. Each signal supplies either a scalar reward bonus or a local, group-relative advantage alongside the final outcome reward (Figure 1 ). Within local credit, we further test whether feedback needs to remain aligned with its source search and whether its benefit is concentrated in groups with tied outcome rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 利用这些标注，我们在相同的观察数据上比较三种检索信号。 基于事实的证据覆盖度（Cov）衡量已检索的标注证据比例；依赖关系覆盖度（Cov-Dep）要求相同证据满足前提关系；答案匹配（AM）则在检索文本中查找参考答案。 每种信号都会在最终结果奖励之外，提供一个标量奖励加成或一个局部、相对于组内的优势值（图1）。 在局部信用机制中，我们进一步检验反馈是否需要与原始搜索保持一致，以及其收益是否集中在结果奖励相同的组内。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate these choices with Qwen3-4B across seven QA benchmarks. Both scalar and local retrieval supervision improve on outcome-only training, with local credit giving the largest gains. Cov-local improves average F1 by 3.09, with a larger gain of 4.81 on multi-hop QA. Our controlled comparisons further show that the effectiveness of a retrieval signal depends on how its credit is incorporated and whether it remains aligned with the action that produced it. These results show that retrieval rewards should be designed together with the way their credit enters the policy update.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Qwen3-4B 在七个问答基准上对这些选择进行了评估。 标量检索监督和本地检索监督均优于仅基于结果的训练，其中本地信用机制带来的提升最大。 Cov-local 将平均 F1 提升了 3.09，在多跳问答任务上的提升更大，达到 4.81。 我们的受控比较进一步表明，检索信号的有效性取决于其信用的整合方式，以及它是否与产生该信号的行动保持一致。 这些结果表明，检索奖励应与信用进入策略更新的方式一同设计。

sents.en: Below, we describe the data and define three retrieval signals and their per-search increments.
sents.zh: 下面，我们将描述数据，并定义三种检索信号及其每次搜索的增量。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate intermediate retrieval during training, we construct questions together with their supporting evidence. A final answer alone cannot identify which intermediate facts a search has recovered. Our construction therefore preserves the subquestions, their dependencies and their source passages alongside each question, providing annotations for retrieval supervision as well as outcome evaluation. Following MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) in composing questions with dependent reasoning steps, we begin with entity pairs that co-occur within a KILT sentence and are linked by a Wikidata relation ( Vrandečić and Krötzsch, 2014 ) . We retain the source passage for each relation, allowing the evidence to be traced back to Wikipedia as relations are combined into questions.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估训练过程中的中间检索，我们构建问题及其支持性证据。 仅凭最终答案无法确定搜索过程中恢复了哪些中间事实。 因此，我们的构建方法保留了每个问题中的子问题、其依赖关系以及来源段落，从而为检索监督和结果评估提供了标注信息。 遵循 MuSiQue（Trivedi 等人，2022）中构建具有依赖推理步骤的问题的方法，我们从 KILT 句子中共同出现且通过 Wikidata 关系（Vrandečić 和 Krötzsch，2014）相互关联的实体对开始。 我们为每个关系保留来源段落，这样在将各个关系组合成问题时，证据就可以追溯至维基百科。

paragraphs.en: We compose these relations into chains and conjunctive structures. For chains, we favour relation types that usually map a subject to one object, and require each selected subject–property pair to have exactly one object. This object can then serve as the subject of a subsequent step. For conjunctive structures, each branch must admit multiple candidates while their intersection identifies a single answer. Within the selected relations, neither branch alone determines the answer, so their combination adds a constraint rather than repeating an already sufficient relation. The resulting decomposition forms a graph in which each node represents a subquestion with its own answer, and directed edges record dependencies on earlier answers. A node can therefore require evidence from multiple passages. For example, “Which university did both person A and person B attend?” combines two education relations into one subquestion. We attach both supporting passages to this node, whereas a node representing a single relation retains that relation’s source passage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这些关系组合成链式和并列结构。 对于链式结构，我们倾向于选择通常能将一个主体映射到一个对象的关系类型，并要求每个选定的主体–属性对恰好有一个对象。 这个对象随后可以作为后续步骤的主体。 对于并列结构，每个分支必须允许多个候选项，而它们的交集则能确定唯一的答案。 在所选的关系中，单独一个分支都无法确定答案，因此它们的组合会增加一个约束，而不是重复一个已经足够充分的关系。 由此产生的分解会形成一个图，其中每个节点代表一个带有自身答案的子问题，而有向边则记录了对先前答案的依赖关系。 因此，一个节点可能需要来自多个段落的支持证据。 例如，“人物 A 和人物 B 都就读于哪所大学？”这一问题将两个教育关系合并为一个子问题。 我们会将两个支持性段落都关联到这个节点，而代表单个关系的节点则会保留该关系的来源段落。

paragraphs.en: Once the structure is selected, GPT-5.6 Luna generates a descriptive reference for each root entity without naming it. Templates use these references and the selected relations to assemble the question, reference answer aliases, subquestions and dependency edges. The graph determines the answer and decomposition; the generated description supplies a way to refer to the starting entity in the question. For each subquestion, we also record the locations of its supporting passages and annotate mentions of its answer within them. These locations connect the generated question to the retriever’s chunks: a node is covered when retrieved chunks match all of its required passages. The graph edges specify which earlier answers a subquestion depends on, while the attached passages specify the evidence needed to answer it. Both coverage signals below use these annotations; answer match uses only the original question’s reference answer aliases.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦结构选定，GPT-5.6 Luna 就会为每个根实体生成一个描述性参考，但不会直接命名该实体。 模板会利用这些参考和选定的关系来组装问题、参考答案别名、子问题以及依赖边。 图结构负责确定答案和分解方式；生成的描述则提供了一种在问题中引用初始实体的方法。 对于每个子问题，我们还会记录其支持性段落的位置，并对其中对其答案的提及进行标注。 这些位置将生成的问题与检索器的文本块连接起来：当检索到的文本块匹配该子问题所需的所有段落时，对应的节点即被视为被覆盖。 图中的边指明了某个子问题依赖于哪些先前的答案，而附带的段落则说明了回答该问题所需的证据。 下方的两种覆盖信号都使用了这些标注；而答案匹配仅使用原始问题中的参考答案别名。

paragraphs.en: We then exclude records with missing grounding, detected graph shortcuts, or unmatched structural categories, and sample deterministically from ten categories covering single-evidence, conjunctive, chain, and fan-in questions. This produces 14,000 training questions shared by all conditions. The training mixture contains 2,500 one-hop, 3,300 two-hop, 4,900 three-hop and 3,300 four-hop questions, grouped by their construction templates. The one-hop subset includes 1,200 single-evidence and 1,300 conjunctive questions; the remaining questions comprise 5,400 chain, 1,600 wide and 4,500 fan-in structures. The mixture therefore includes both sequential dependencies and evidence combined across branches. These categories describe annotated structures, not the number of searches an agent must execute.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，我们排除缺少 grounding、检测到图捷径或结构类别不匹配的记录，并从涵盖单证据、合取、链式和扇入问题的十个类别中进行确定性采样。 由此生成了所有条件共用的 14,000 条训练问题。 训练混合集包含 2,500 条一跳问题、3,300 条二跳问题、4,900 条三跳问题和 3,300 条四跳问题，并按其构建模板进行分组。 一跳子集包括 1,200 条单证据问题和 1,300 条合取问题；其余问题则包含 5,400 条链式结构、1,600 条宽结构以及 4,500 条扇入结构。 因此，该混合集既包含了顺序依赖关系，也包含了跨分支组合的证据。 这些类别描述的是标注的结构，而非智能体必须执行搜索的次数。

paragraphs.en: We further conduct controlled comparisons within the local formulation to examine event--action correspondence and which outcome groups benefit from retrieval credit. First, the permutation conditions test whether retrieval credit needs to remain aligned with the action that produced it. They shuffle nonzero signed event masses across rollouts for the same question at the same search step, preserving the available credit while breaking event--action correspondence. Second, the outcome-group restrictions test whether local credit is useful mainly when the outcome reward cannot distinguish trajectories. For both Cov and AM, flat-only retains local credit only in groups with tied answer scores, where the outcome advantage is zero; no-flat retains it only in groups with differing scores. Both retain the outcome advantage and leave the remaining local updates unscaled. These restrictions therefore compare where local credit is applied while also reducing its total amount. 2 2 2 Appendix A gives signal-matching rules, eligibility and normalisation checks, and details of permutation and outcome-group gating.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在局部公式内部进一步进行受控比较，以检验事件与动作的对应关系，以及哪些结果组能从检索信用中受益。 首先，排列条件用于测试检索信用是否需要保持与产生它的那个动作一致。 它们将同一问题在同一搜索步骤的不同展开过程中的非零符号事件质量进行打乱，从而在打破事件与动作对应关系的同时保留可用的信用。 其次，结果组限制用于测试局部信用是否主要在结果奖励无法区分不同轨迹时才有用。 对于 Cov 和 AM 两种方法，flat-only 仅在答案分数相同的结果组中保留局部信用（此时结果优势为零）；no-flat 则仅在分数不同的结果组中保留局部信用。 两种方法都保留了结果优势，并使其余的局部更新保持未缩放状态。 因此，这些限制既比较了局部信用的应用位置，也减少了其总量。2 2 2 附录 A 提供了信号匹配规则、资格和归一化检查，以及排列和结果组门控的细节。

paragraphs.en: We train Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) on the same 14,000 questions. The searchable corpus is the KILT-2019 Wikipedia corpus ( Petroni et al., 2021 ) , partitioned into over 29 million 100-word chunks. Retrieval uses E5-base-v2 ( Wang et al., 2022 ) and returns three chunks per query. The retriever remains fixed during policy optimisation. Training uses GRPO with five rollouts per question and the same training budget across conditions. The outcome reward is answer F1, r i = F1 ⁡ ( y i , y ∗ ) r_{i}=\mathrm{F1}(y_{i},y^{*}) . Our baseline, outcome-only training (OO), uses this reward without retrieval supervision. All conditions share the clipped policy objective and KL regularisation, differing only in the reward or token advantage supplied to the objective. Group standardisation uses the sample standard deviation with ϵ = 10 − 6 \epsilon=10^{-6} . All results use the final checkpoint and greedy decoding. Appendix A gives the remaining settings.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows that local incorporation outperforms scalar incorporation for each retrieval signal, with the largest gain for evidence coverage. Cov-local achieves 54.34 average F1, compared with 51.25 for outcome-only training. All three scalar variants also improve over OO, but assigning credit locally yields further gains whose size depends on the retrieval signal. The signal ranking also changes: Cov is strongest under local incorporation, whereas Cov-Dep is strongest under scalar incorporation.
paragraphs.zh: 表1显示，对于每种检索信号，局部整合的表现均优于标量整合，其中证据覆盖方面的提升最为显著。 Cov-local 的平均 F1 分数为 54.34，而仅使用结果进行训练时则为 51.25。 三种标量变体也都在 OO 的基础上有所改进，但将功劳归因于局部整合能带来进一步的提升，其提升幅度取决于检索信号。 信号的排名也发生了变化：在局部整合下，Cov 的表现最强；而在标量整合下，Cov-Dep 的表现最强。

paragraphs.en: Comparing Cov with Cov-Dep shows how dependency constraints affect scalar and local training differently. Both use the same evidence nodes and grounding, but Cov credits a newly covered node before its prerequisites are retrieved. Removing dependency closure raises local F1 from 52.96 to 54.34, whereas scalar F1 changes from 52.82 to 52.64 (Figure 3 a). The two formulations use retrieval events differently: scalar incorporation sums them before group normalisation, while local incorporation compares them at each search step. Even when two event sequences end at the same coverage, they can produce different local updates. This distinction helps explain why signal construction must be considered together with incorporation.
paragraphs.zh: 将 Cov 与 Cov-Dep 进行比较，可以展示依赖约束如何以不同方式影响标量训练和局部训练。 两者使用相同的证据节点和接地机制，但 Cov 会在检索其前提条件之前，先为刚刚被覆盖的节点赋予信用。 移除依赖闭包使局部 F1 从 52.96 提升至 54.34，而标量 F1 则从 52.82 变为 52.64（图 3a）。 这两种公式对检索事件的使用方式不同：标量整合在群体归一化之前对这些事件求和，而局部整合则在每个搜索步骤中进行比较。 即使两个事件序列最终达到相同的覆盖状态，它们也可能产生不同的局部更新。 这种差异有助于解释为何必须将信号构建与整合过程一并考虑。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows that both Cov-local and AM-local improve multi-hop and single-hop QA, with larger gains on multi-hop QA. Cov-local has a larger advantage on multi-hop QA, while AM-local slightly exceeds it on single-hop QA. The clearer distinction is on multi-hop QA, where tracking evidence for intermediate subquestions yields a larger gain than matching the final answer string. The benefit of local incorporation nevertheless depends on the signal and task group. Cov-Dep-local improves over its scalar counterpart on multi-hop QA but falls below it on single-hop QA. Both Cov-local and AM-local improve over OO on all seven benchmarks, extending their benefits across both task groups.

paragraphs.en: We examine how preserving event–action correspondence and choosing which outcome groups receive retrieval credit affect performance. We then analyse evidence acquisition by the trained policies on the annotated development questions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了如何保持事件与动作的对应关系，以及选择哪些结果组获得检索信用，这些因素对性能的影响。 接着，我们分析了训练好的策略在已标注的开发问题上的证据获取情况。

sents.en: We examine how preserving event–action correspondence and choosing which outcome groups receive retrieval credit affect performance.
sents.zh: 我们研究了如何保持事件与动作的对应关系，以及选择哪些结果组获得检索信用，这些因素对性能的影响。

sents.en: We then analyse evidence acquisition by the trained policies on the annotated development questions.
sents.zh: 接着，我们分析了训练好的策略在已标注的开发问题上的证据获取情况。

paragraphs.en: Local credit links a search action to the evidence it retrieves. We test whether this link matters by comparing aligned credit with permuted credit for both Cov and AM. In the aligned condition, each eligible search receives the credit computed from its own retrieval event. In the permuted condition, we shuffle nonzero signed event masses across rollouts for the same question at the same search step. Credit still applies to query tokens, and the shuffle preserves the signed event masses; it changes which search receives each credit.
paragraphs.zh: 局部信用将搜索动作与其检索到的证据关联起来。 我们通过比较 Cov 和 AM 中对齐信用与打乱信用，来检验这种关联是否重要。 在对齐条件下，每次符合条件的搜索都会获得根据其自身检索事件计算出的信用。 在打乱条件下，我们将同一问题、同一搜索步骤中不同展开的非零有符号事件质量进行打乱。 信用仍然适用于查询词元，且打乱操作保留了有符号事件质量；它改变的只是哪个搜索获得了每项信用。

sents.en: Local credit links a search action to the evidence it retrieves.
sents.zh: 局部信用将搜索动作与其检索到的证据关联起来。

sents.en: We test whether this link matters by comparing aligned credit with permuted credit for both Cov and AM.
sents.zh: 我们通过比较 Cov 和 AM 中对齐信用与打乱信用，来检验这种关联是否重要。

sents.en: In the aligned condition, each eligible search receives the credit computed from its own retrieval event.
sents.zh: 在对齐条件下，每次符合条件的搜索都会获得根据其自身检索事件计算出的信用。

sents.zh: 在打乱条件下，我们将同一问题、同一搜索步骤中不同展开的非零有符号事件质量进行打乱。

sents.en: Credit still applies to query tokens, and the shuffle preserves the signed event masses; it changes which search receives each credit.
sents.zh: 信用仍然适用于查询词元，且打乱操作保留了有符号事件质量；它改变的只是哪个搜索获得了每项信用。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 b shows that aligned credit outperforms permuted credit for both signals, increasing average F1 by 2.12 for Cov and 3.12 for AM. The advantage is larger on multi-hop QA than on single-hop QA. This pattern suggests that associating feedback with the search that produced it is particularly useful when answering a question requires several pieces of evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3b 显示，对于两种信号，对齐的信用评分均优于打乱的信用评分，使 Cov 的平均 F1 值提升了 2.12，AM 的平均 F1 值提升了 3.12。 在多跳问答任务中，这种优势比单跳问答任务更大。 这一模式表明，当回答一个问题需要多个证据时，将反馈与生成该反馈的搜索过程关联起来会特别有效。

sents.en: Figure 3 b shows that aligned credit outperforms permuted credit for both signals, increasing average F1 by 2.12 for Cov and 3.12 for AM.
sents.zh: 图 3b 显示，对于两种信号，对齐的信用评分均优于打乱的信用评分，使 Cov 的平均 F1 值提升了 2.12，AM 的平均 F1 值提升了 3.12。

paragraphs.en: Compared with OO, Cov-permute still achieves higher F1 (52.22 versus 51.25), while AM-permute performs worse (50.39). Coverage supervision therefore retains some benefit even when credit is reassigned, but preserving the correspondence raises F1 further to 54.34. For both signals, assigning credit to its source search is more effective than randomly reassigning it among searches.
paragraphs.zh: 与 OO 相比，Cov-permute 仍然实现了更高的 F1（52.22 对比 51.25），而 AM-permute 的表现则更差（50.39）。 因此，即使信用被重新分配，覆盖监督仍保留部分益处，但保持对应关系可将 F1 进一步提升至 54.34。 对于这两种信号而言，将信用分配给其来源搜索比在多个搜索之间随机重新分配更为有效。

sents.en: Compared with OO, Cov-permute still achieves higher F1 (52.22 versus 51.25), while AM-permute performs worse (50.39).
sents.zh: 与 OO 相比，Cov-permute 仍然实现了更高的 F1（52.22 对比 51.25），而 AM-permute 的表现则更差（50.39）。

paragraphs.en: For both Cov and AM, we compare local credit applied to all rollout groups with flat-only, which retains it only in groups with tied answer scores, and no-flat, which retains it only in groups with differing scores.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Cov 和 AM，我们将应用于所有展开组的局部信用与仅保留平坦组的情况进行比较；后者仅在答案分数相同的组中保留该信用，而“无平坦”方案则仅在分数不同的组中保留该信用。

paragraphs.en: For both signals, using all groups gives the highest aggregate F1, followed by no-flat and then flat-only (Figure 3 c). For Cov, excluding tied-outcome groups reduces F1 by 0.32, whereas retaining only those groups reduces it by 2.27. AM follows the same ordering, with losses of 1.44 and 2.19, respectively. Thus useful retrieval supervision is not confined to groups where the outcome reward cannot distinguish trajectories. Cov-flat-only remains above OO, while AM-flat-only performs similarly to OO. Both restrictions reduce the amount of local credit as well as changing which groups receive it.
paragraphs.zh: 对于两种信号，使用所有分组可获得最高的聚合 F1 值，其次是 no-flat，然后是 flat-only（图 3c）。 对于 Cov，排除结果相同的分组会使 F1 降低 0.32，而仅保留这些分组则会使 F1 降低 2.27。 AM 也遵循相同的排序，损失分别为 1.44 和 2.19。 因此，有用的检索监督并不局限于结果奖励无法区分轨迹的分组。 Cov-flat-only 仍高于 OO，而 AM-flat-only 的表现与 OO 相似。 这两种限制都会减少局部信用的数量，并改变哪些分组会获得该信用。

paragraphs.en: RAG ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) combines language generation with evidence from an external corpus. Multi-turn agents extend this interaction by deciding what to retrieve as reasoning proceeds. ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) provides a general framework for interleaving reasoning and actions. Search-o1 ( Li et al., 2025a ) integrates search into the reasoning process to retrieve missing knowledge. Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025b ) and ReSearch ( Chen et al., 2025 ) train search behaviour with reinforcement learning and answer feedback. An empirical study by Jin et al. (2025a) reports limited gains from intermediate retrieval rewards in the settings examined. We study how their effectiveness depends on the way retrieval credit enters the policy update.
paragraphs.zh: RAG（Lewis 等人，2020）将语言生成与来自外部语料库的证据相结合。 多轮智能体通过根据推理进展决定检索哪些信息来扩展这种交互。 ReAct（Yao 等人，2023）为交替进行推理和行动提供了一个通用框架。 Search-o1（Li 等人，2025a）将搜索整合到推理过程中，以检索缺失的知识。 Search-R1（Jin 等人，2025b）和 ReSearch（Chen 等人，2025）通过强化学习和答案反馈来训练搜索行为。 Jin 等人进行的一项实证研究 （2025a）报告称，在受检验的设置中，中间检索奖励带来的增益有限。 我们研究了其有效性如何取决于检索信用进入策略更新的方式。

paragraphs.en: Lightman et al. (2024) study process supervision for mathematical reasoning, providing feedback on intermediate steps rather than only the final result. For retrieval, R3-RAG ( Li et al., 2025b ) combines answer correctness with document-relevance rewards. SWiRL ( Goldie et al., 2025 ) decomposes multi-step reasoning and tool-use trajectories into action-level sub-trajectories for data filtering and RL optimisation. More recent search-agent methods assess different aspects of retrieval progress. HiPRAG ( Wu et al., 2026 ) evaluates search necessity and adds a hierarchical process bonus to outcome and format rewards. BiCAA ( Huang et al., 2026 ) combines forward answer-solvability gains with hindsight estimates of a search step’s importance for the final answer. Our study uses corpus-grounded annotations to compare answer matching with evidence coverage. The two coverage variants share their grounding and differ in whether prerequisite relations constrain credit, allowing us to trace that choice through the resulting updates.
paragraphs.zh: Lightman 等人 (2024) 研究了数学推理中的过程监督方法，该方法不仅对最终结果提供反馈，还对中间步骤进行反馈。 在检索方面，R3-RAG（Li 等人，2025b）将答案正确性与文档相关性奖励相结合。 SWiRL（Goldie 等人，2025）将多步推理和工具使用轨迹分解为行动层面的子轨迹，用于数据过滤和强化学习优化。 近期的一些搜索智能体方法则对检索进展的不同方面进行评估。 HiPRAG（Wu 等人，2026）评估了搜索的必要性，并在结果奖励和格式奖励中加入了分层过程奖励。 BiCAA（Huang 等人，2026）将正向答案可解性的提升与事后对搜索步骤对最终答案重要性的估计相结合。 我们的研究使用基于语料的标注来比较答案匹配与证据覆盖情况。 这两种覆盖变体共享相同的依据，但不同之处在于前提关系是否对信用分配构成约束，这使我们能够追踪该选择在后续更新中的影响。

paragraphs.en: An intermediate signal also requires a rule for assigning credit to the policy. STAMP ( Xu et al., 2026 ) verifies cited evidence against a reference graph, attributes it to the action that first exposed it, and modulates the outcome advantage without changing its sign. GDCR ( Liu et al., 2026 ) rewards newly retrieved and cited entities according to their graph distance to the answer; SAPO standardises these rewards across steps within each trajectory and scales their contribution by the absolute outcome advantage. CW-GRPO ( Wang et al., 2026 ) uses an LLM judge to assess retrieval utility and reasoning correctness, redistributing outcome advantage across successful search rounds while assigning uniform weights to failed trajectories.

We compare retrieval events across rollouts of the same question at the same search step and add the resulting signed residual to selected tokens. paragraphs.en: The interaction between reward construction and update strength also warrants closer study. paragraphs.en: Our study shows that intermediate retrieval supervision should be designed together with its credit assignment. Using corpus-grounded questions with intermediate evidence annotations, we find that the same retrieval signal has different effects depending on how it enters the policy update. Dependency constraints help distinguish this interaction: requiring prerequisites benefits scalar incorporation, while crediting evidence as it is acquired works better under local incorporation. A more constrained evidence signal therefore does not necessarily provide more useful supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究表明，中间检索监督应与其信用分配共同设计。 通过使用基于语料库且带有中间证据标注的问题，我们发现相同的检索信号在进入策略更新的方式不同时会产生不同的效果。 依赖约束有助于区分这种相互作用：要求先决条件对标量整合有益，而将证据在获取时即予以归因则更适合局部整合。 因此，更受约束的证据信号并不一定能够提供更有用的监督。

sents.en: Using corpus-grounded questions with intermediate evidence annotations, we find that the same retrieval signal has different effects depending on how it enters the policy update.
sents.zh: 通过使用基于语料库且带有中间证据标注的问题，我们发现相同的检索信号在进入策略更新的方式不同时会产生不同的效果。

sents.en: Dependency constraints help distinguish this interaction: requiring prerequisites benefits scalar incorporation, while crediting evidence as it is acquired works better under local incorporation.
sents.zh: 依赖约束有助于区分这种相互作用：要求先决条件对标量整合有益，而将证据在获取时即予以归因则更适合局部整合。

sents.en: A more constrained evidence signal therefore does not necessarily provide more useful supervision.
sents.zh: 因此，更受约束的证据信号并不一定能够提供更有用的监督。

paragraphs.en: Across our experiments, local retrieval credit is most effective when it remains associated with the search that produced the evidence and complements outcome supervision across both tied and differing outcome groups. Its value extends beyond supplying an update when answer rewards are tied. On the development questions, higher coverage and similar coverage-conditioned F1 suggest that local supervision primarily changes evidence acquisition, leaving evidence use as a separate question. Together, these findings support treating evidence scoring and action-level credit assignment as coupled design choices when training search agents.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的各项实验中，当局部检索信用与产生证据的搜索过程保持关联，并且能够同时补充结果一致组和结果差异组中的结果监督时，其效果最为显著。 其价值不仅限于在答案奖励一致的情况下提供更新。 在开发问题中，更高的覆盖率和受覆盖率条件影响的相似 F1 值表明，局部监督主要改变了证据的获取方式，而证据的使用则是一个独立的问题。 综合来看，这些发现支持在训练搜索智能体时，将证据评分与行动层面的信用分配视为相互关联的设计选择。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3’s native tool interface supports parallel tool calling. We retain this interface and execute only the first query in each search call to keep the retrieval budget per call fixed across conditions. This controls an additional source of variation while we compare reward construction and credit assignment. The tool response reports any ignored queries, which can be issued in later turns. All training conditions share this rule, and a trajectory may contain multiple calls.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3 的原生工具接口支持并行工具调用。 我们保留此接口，并在每次搜索调用中仅执行第一个查询，以确保每次调用的检索预算在不同条件下保持一致。 在比较奖励构建和信用分配时，这控制了一个额外的变异性来源。 工具响应会报告任何被忽略的查询，这些查询可以在后续回合中发出。 所有训练条件都遵循这一规则，且一条轨迹可能包含多次调用。

paragraphs.en: Several atomic nodes can share a supporting paragraph. We merge shared supporting paragraphs when assigning structural categories for sampling, while preserving the original atomic nodes and prerequisites used by Cov-Dep and Cov. The resulting categories describe annotated evidence structure rather than the agent’s search count. To map evidence to indexed chunks, we remove the page’s initial title entry, retain section and bullet marker lines, join the remaining text with newlines, and split it into non-overlapping 100-word chunks. Grounding normalises page and paragraph identifiers and locates answer mentions within these spans; the coverage rule in Section 2 also checks page identity.
paragraphs.zh: 多个原子节点可以共享一个支撑段落。 在采样时分配结构类别时，我们会合并共享的支撑段落，同时保留 Cov-Dep 和 Cov 使用的原始原子节点和前提条件。 由此产生的类别描述的是标注证据的结构，而非智能体的搜索次数。 为了将证据映射到已索引的片段中，我们会移除页面的初始标题条目，保留章节和项目符号标记行，用换行符连接剩余文本，并将其分割为互不重叠的 100 词片段。 基础处理会标准化页面和段落标识符，并定位这些片段内的答案提及；第 2 节中的覆盖规则也会检查页面身份。

paragraphs.en: We sample deterministically within each structural category, reserving 1,200 questions for the evidence-coverage analysis in Section 5.3 and selecting 14,000 training questions from the remainder. We refer to the reserved questions as the development split. Of 87,171 source questions, 86,681 are eligible: 168 fail the chunk-grounding eligibility check, 297 are labelled graph shortcuts by the construction filter, and 25 do not match a requested category. For the first four categories, half the selected records have all gold evidence in the first chunk of each supporting page and half require later chunks. Other categories are sampled from their full eligible pools.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在每个结构类别内进行确定性采样，保留 1,200 个问题用于第 5.3 节的证据覆盖分析，并从其余问题中选出 14,000 个训练问题。 我们将这些保留的问题称为开发集。 在 87,171 个源问题中，有 86,681 个问题符合资格：其中 168 个未通过分块依据资格检查，297 个被构建过滤器标记为图捷径，另有 25 个与所请求的类别不匹配。 对于前四个类别，所选记录中有一半的所有黄金证据都位于每个支持页面的第一个分块中，而另一半则需要后续的分块。 其他类别则从其完整的合格池中采样。

paragraphs.en: Each record contains a question, answer aliases, a decomposition, dependency references, and corpus grounding. The selected data contain 44,385 graph nodes, including 8,050 conjunctive nodes. The retrieval index contains approximately 29 million chunks represented by normalised 768-dimensional embeddings. Every node is grounded in the corpus, every prerequisite refers to an existing node, and the dependency graphs are acyclic.
paragraphs.zh: 每条记录都包含一个问题、答案别名、分解结构、依赖引用以及语料库基础。 所选数据包含 44,385 个图节点，其中包括 8,050 个合取节点。 检索索引包含约 2900 万个由归一化 768 维嵌入表示的片段。 每个节点都有语料库基础，每个前提条件都引用一个现有节点，且依赖图是无环的。

paragraphs.en: Each node stores a list of required source passages, identified by Wikipedia page and paragraph, and the character spans of its subquestion-answer mentions in each passage. For every required passage, the detector checks whether any retrieved chunk has the same page and paragraph and contains the start offset of at least one annotated mention. A node is covered only if this test succeeds for all of its required passages. Different passages may be matched by different chunks and at different search steps. Both Cov and Cov-Dep use this check; dependency closure is applied separately by Cov-Dep. The check does not require the entire answer mention or supporting sentence to fit inside the chunk, as quantified below.
paragraphs.zh: 每个节点都存储一个所需源段落的列表，这些段落通过维基百科页面和段落进行标识，并记录其子问题-答案提及在每个段落中的字符跨度。 对于每个所需段落，检测器会检查是否有检索到的片段具有相同的页面和段落，并且包含至少一个已标注提及的起始偏移量。 只有当该检测对其所有所需段落都成功时，一个节点才算被覆盖。 不同的段落可能由不同的片段在不同搜索步骤中被匹配到。 Cov 和 Cov-Dep 都使用这种检测方法；依赖闭包则由 Cov-Dep 单独应用。 该检测不要求整个答案提及或支持性句子都必须包含在片段内，具体量化如下所示。

paragraphs.en: All 15,200 selected questions begin with the same “What is the name of” surface template. Normalised answer-alias strings occur in 57 training and 5 development questions. These matches include ordinary-word collisions and aliases embedded in longer names, as well as potential answer cues. There is no exact question-ID or normalised-question overlap between the two splits, but 225 development questions have all gold evidence seen in training and 282 have partial evidence overlap; only 693 have fully unseen gold evidence. The development split contains 531 questions sharing a training page and 606 sharing an answer entity. This split is reserved separately from the benchmark evaluation; the shared evidence limits its value for measuring generalisation.

paragraphs.en: The trajectory measurements use 7,680 training trajectories collected before the final-policy comparisons.

paragraphs.en: Table 5 shows how chunk boundaries and dependency constraints affect retrieval progress.
